channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Kataguiri chama Zema de “arregão” após desistência de debate
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) called Romeu Zema (Novo) a coward ("arregão") after the former governor of Minas Gerais withdrew from the Band presidential debate scheduled for Sunday. Zema's decision came after the confirmed absences of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) from the event.

item.title: Tema central da eleição, Lulinha reaviva rixa entre advogado e chefe do PT
item.description: Investigations into Lulinha's alleged influence peddling reignited rivalry between lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho and PT leader Edinho Silva. Marco Aurélio became the main defender of Lula and his son against accusations from Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar, countering that opponents use politically instrumentalized Federal Police sectors because they lack votes and a government program.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que "pode mais" e pede novo "voto de confiança" em SP
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), running for reelection, asked voters for a new 'vote of confidence' at the launch of Renata Abreu's (Podemos) candidacy for the Chamber of Deputies. He highlighted his administration's achievements and defended expanding TEA Centers for mothers of autistic children, while also endorsing Senate candidates and Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB). The campaign strategy prioritizes female voters.

item.title: Eleitores participam de eleição simulada no Maranhão
item.description: Voters in Paulino Neves, Maranhão, participated in a TSE-simulated election to test systems for the 2026 General Elections. The simulation involved 1,398 volunteers (9.22% of the electorate), 24 polling stations, and training of poll workers, with no reported issues.

item.title: Zema desiste de participar do debate na ‘Band’
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) withdrew from the Band TV debate just hours before its scheduled start on Sunday. Lula's (PT) expected absence, which prompted the change, joins Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) likely no-show, leaving the event with only Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Mission) and Augusto Cury (Avante).

item.title: Romeu Zema desiste de debate presidencial da Band devido à ‘ausência de Lula e outros concorrentes’
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) dropped out of the Bandeirantes presidential debate scheduled for this Sunday (23), joining the earlier withdrawals of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). His campaign argued the date was moved to accommodate Lula, so without him and other rivals the debate lost its purpose. The event is now expected to feature only Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão) and Augusto Cury (Avante), with three thematic blocks starting at 8 p.m. (Brasília time).

item.title: Sem Lula, Flávio e Zema, Caiado diz que vai a debate: "Não dou marcha ré"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) confirmed he will attend the first 2026 presidential debate on Sunday (Aug 13) on Band, stating he 'doesn't back down.' The event will feature only three candidates—Caiado, Augusto Cury (Avante), and Renan Santos (Missão)—after the absences of Lula (PT), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and Romeu Zema (Novo), the latter declining due to the absence of the leading frontrunners.

item.title: Para adversários, Zema desistiu de candidatura ao não ir a debate
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) skipped the Band debate, which rivals interpreted as a withdrawal due to low poll numbers. Zema's campaign argues the debate lost relevance without Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. He will compensate with an interview on Jornal Nacional.

item.title: Advogado herda número de Marçal e se lança candidato pelo União Brasil
item.description: Lawyer Tassio Renam, Pablo Marçal's ally, was registered by União Brasil as a federal deputy candidate inheriting number 4444. Marçal returned to PRTB to run for President but remains ineligible for 8 years. The party's strategy is to transfer Marçal's voter base, which nearly reached São Paulo's 2024 runoff, to his former right-hand man.

item.title: Marcola pode virar um novo ‘Mauro Cid’? No Planalto, muita gente está preocupada
item.description: VEJA magazine revealed that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger paid personal expenses of Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former chief of staff to Lula, in a scheme investigated by the Federal Police. Despite the revelations, Lula defends the former aide, but there are concerns at the Presidential Palace that he could become a 'new Mauro Cid' if abandoned.

item.title: Planos de candidatos à Presidência têm de 7 a 200 páginas
item.description: The 2026 presidential campaign plans range from 7 to 200 pages, with no clear correlation between length and detail. Augusto Cury (Avante) leads with 200 pages, while Rui Costa Pimenta (PCO) has the shortest at 7 pages. Documents include proposals, financial simulations, and action schedules, reflecting varied strategic approaches.

item.title: Lula estuda medida de duplo alcance eleitoral
item.description: Lula announces a 200+ billion reais package to boost popularity and re-election bid, but remains in a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro in runoff polls. The president considers raising Bolsa Família payments before October to address cost-of-living complaints and reduce abstention among low-income voters — his core base — mirroring Bolsonaro's 2022 strategy.

item.title: MPE libera foto de Lula com chapéu na urna eletrônica
item.description: Brazil's Electoral Prosecutor's Office (MPE) defended before the TSE the validation of Lula's photo for the electronic ballot, in which the president appears wearing a hat on medical recommendation after the removal of a skin cancer lesion. The Deputy Prosecutor-General stated that the accessory does not constitute campaign propaganda nor hinders the candidate's identification, serving political pluralism. The choice divided experts, as the item is not part of the PT politician's historical visual identification.

item.title: Que horas é o debate presidencial? Band promove primeiro debate neste domingo; veja como assistir
item.description: The first open-TV presidential debate will air on Band at 8 PM this Sunday. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro have not confirmed attendance, and Romeu Zema withdrew. The debate will feature Augusto Cury, Renan Santos, and Ronaldo Caiado.

item.title: Lula dá entrevista à Record e fala sobre Lulinha, Marcola e Trump
item.description: President Lula gave an interview to TV Record at the Alvorada Palace, addressing investigations involving his son Lulinha and former chief of staff Marcola, reiterating that anyone who committed irregularities must answer for their actions. He also discussed his phone call with US President Donald Trump and topics such as public security and education. The interview, conducted by journalist Mariana Godoy, was scheduled to air on Sunday night.

item.title: Renan Santos confirma presença em debate e critica “descompromisso” de candidatos
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão) confirmed his participation in the Band debate on Sunday, 23rd, despite Romeu Zema's (Novo) withdrawal. He strongly criticized the absence of other candidates, calling it a 'shame' and 'lack of commitment'.

item.title: Lula vai ao debate hoje? Veja quem deve participar do encontro na Band
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate is scheduled for today on Band, but it will not feature the two frontrunners in the race for the Planalto Palace: President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The absence of the polling leaders raises questions about the format and relevance of the event for voters.

item.title: Zema cancela participação no debate eleitoral promovido por Band e Estadão
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for the Novo Party, withdrew from the electoral debate hosted by Band and Estadão, scheduled for today at 8 PM. The event is co-hosted by TV Cultura, Gazeta, and Jovem Pan. The reason for his absence was not disclosed.

item.title: Zema cancela participação em debate da Band deste domingo e justifica falta por ausência de Lula
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) withdrew from Sunday's Band debate, citing Lula's absence as removing the event's purpose. The debate was rescheduled from August 16 to 23 hoping Lula would attend, but he did not confirm. Flávio Bolsonaro is also not expected to participate.

item.title: Foto de Lula com chapéu na urna não é propaganda eleitoral, diz MP
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry considers Lula's photo with a Panama hat on the ballot neither electoral propaganda nor an obstacle to voter recognition. The accessory was adopted on medical advice following skin cancer treatment and is deemed appropriate attire under TSE rules.

item.title: Kim Kataguiri provoca Zema após desistência de debate: "Arregão"
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) called presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) a 'coward' after Zema withdrew from the Band TV debate scheduled for Sunday. Zema justified his absence by saying the rescheduling lost its purpose without the presence of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The debate is expected to feature Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Augusto Cury (Avante).

item.title: Sem Lula e Flávio, Zema desiste de debate da Band
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) withdrew from the first 2026 presidential debate, hosted by Band this Sunday (23), following the confirmed absences of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The debate is scheduled for 8 PM in São Paulo, and Zema's departure changes the lineup of confirmed participants.

item.title: Zema desiste de debate da Band e atribui decisão à ausência de Lula
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) pulled out of the Band TV debate scheduled for Sunday, August 23, 2026, after learning that President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL)—the two front-runners in the polls—would not attend. His campaign said the date change from August 16 had only been accepted under the expectation that Lula would participate, and that without him the rescheduling 'lost its original purpose.' The statement also reaffirmed Novo's opposition to Lula's government and the PT.

item.title: “Teto de 12 anos é garantir impunidade”, diz advogado da Ficha Limpa
item.description: Lawyer Marlon Reis, one of the creators of Brazil's Ficha Limpa (Clean Record) law, called congressional changes to the legislation a 'guarantee of impunity,' criticizing a 12-year cap on ineligibility for administrative misconduct convictions and an earlier start to the ineligibility countdown. The amendments are being reviewed by the Supreme Court, where Justice Gilmar Mendes has returned the case files and is considering diverging from Justice Cármen Lúcia's ruling on two points.

item.title: Sem Lula e Flávio, Zema decide não participar de debate na Band
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) announced he will not participate in the first 2026 presidential debate on Band, scheduled for August 23, following the confirmed absences of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). His team argued the date change was only accepted under the expectation of Lula's presence to ensure plurality. The debate is expected to feature only Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Augusto Cury (Avante), as Pablo Marçal (PRTB) was barred by the TSE.

item.title: Band promove primeiro debate entre os candidatos a presidente neste domingo; saiba quem vai participar
item.description: TV Band will host on Sunday at 8 pm the first open-TV debate among candidates for Brazil's presidency in 2026, broadcast across multiple Band platforms from São Paulo. The participants will be Augusto Cury (Avante), Renan Santos (Missão), and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD). President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) did not confirm attendance, while Romeu Zema (Novo) withdrew due to the absence of the PT representative.

item.title: Eleitores de direita e de esquerda concordam sobre Estado forte na economia
item.description: A digital survey by Ipsos shows that anti-Lula and anti-Bolsonaro voters agree on the need for a strong state in the economy, explaining why a liberal third way finds no space in Brazil. José Roberto de Toledo discusses this convergence on the A Hora program on Canal UOL.

item.title: O que preocupa o Planalto nessa estadia prolongada de Lulinha na Espanha
item.description: Leaked documents and messages suggest that Fábio Lula, the president's son, may lead an influence lobby within the government, linked to an external lobbyist and politicians tied to the 'petrolão' scandal. Despite investigations, he continues a leisurely life in Spain, worrying the Planalto leadership due to reputational risks for Lula.

item.title: O que diferencia o lobby legítimo da atuação do grupo de Lulinha
item.description: The group around Fabio Luís, 'Lulinha', used family proximity to President Lula to influence public policies, distinct from legitimate lobbying based on technical arguments and transparency. PF investigations reveal corrupt practices, such as covering personal expenses and loans to civil servants, harmful to democracy.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira já arrecadou R$ 53,9 mil em vaquinha para a campanha
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) declared to the TSE R$53,900 raised through online crowdfunding with 2,046 donations. His assets grew 10,488% in four years, rising from R$36,000 to R$3.8 million, including investments of R$2 million and a property valued at R$2.2 million with a debt of R$1.7 million.

item.title: Dino diz que indicação de emendas de dirigentes partidários é nula e ameaça multar Podemos e Solidariedade por falta de resposta
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino gave Podemos and Solidariedade a five-day deadline to explain whether their party leaderships participate in the allocation of parliamentary amendments, under a daily fine of R$ 100,000. The parties failed to respond to a previous summons, while 19 other parties told the STF their presidents have no quotas or mechanisms to allocate amendments. Dino reiterated that budget resource allocation belongs exclusively to elected parliamentarians, not party leaders without mandates.

item.title: Moro recebeu R$ 200 mil em doações de sócios em empresa de energia
item.description: Sergio Moro (PL) received R$200,000 in donations from partners of Rejaile Group, an energy company, as declared to the TSE. Jefferson and Mauricio Abou Rejaile each donated R$100,000, while Anna Carolina Nabhan and Fariz Mitri Nabhan contributed R$20,000 and R$5,000, respectively. Donations comply with electoral rules limiting individual contributions and requiring financial transparency.

item.title: Eduardo reposta críticas a Michelle: “Triste, mas verdadeiro”
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) resumed criticism of his sister Michelle Bolsonaro, agreeing with influencer Allan dos Santos on distrust in her political trajectory. He reiterated preference for Bia Kicis and Sebastião Coelho over Michelle in the DF race, maintaining stance against the leading candidate. The position comes amid recent reconciliation between the Bolsonaro siblings.

item.title: Sem citar Lula, Flávio faz discurso curto em Barretos com aceno para o Agro sem apresentar proposta para o setor
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro spoke at the Peão de Barretos festival, emphasizing agribusiness without presenting specific sector proposals. He avoided mentioning Lula, but part of the audience cursed the socialist leader. The candidate reaffirmed support for farming and his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Dino determina nulidade de emendas decididas por dirigentes partidários e ex-parlamentares
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered the nullity of parliamentary amendments decided by party leaders or former lawmakers, following an investigation launched after statements by PL leader Valdemar da Costa Neto. Dino emphasized that such allocations are unconstitutional and requested statements from all parties represented in Congress. Most parties denied the existence of mechanisms for allocating amendments by leadership, and documents will be sent to the Federal Police for analysis.

item.title: As estatísticas na área de segurança pública que podem favorecer a campanha de Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas leads 2026 polling at 50%, benefiting from positive public security statistics, including declining rates of intentional violent deaths. His campaign highlights the creation of an Intelligence and Innovation Center and joint operations with the city government, though Haddad criticizes the transparency of these figures.

item.title: Brilha uma estrelinha
item.description: Brazilian media spent months scrutinizing the relationship between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro over the film Dark Horse, which raised suspicions due to its secret millionaire sponsorship. The case damaged Flávio Bolsonaro’s image, with no explanations about the funding’s origin.

item.title: Apenas 12 dos 54 ex-ministros do governo Bolsonaro estarão nas urnas em outubro
item.description: Out of 54 former Bolsonaro ministers, only 12 (22%) will run in October's elections for state, Senate, gubernatorial, and Chamber positions. Half seek reelection, while others finish their terms or face imprisonment related to the coup plot.

item.title: Elche x Barcelona na La Liga: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Elche hosts Barcelona this Sunday at 16:30 Brasília time at the Martínez Valero Stadium in the second round of LaLiga 2026/27, broadcast exclusively by CazéTV. Barcelona, the reigning champion, begins defending its title after major squad changes, while Elche aims to leverage home support.

item.title: País que mais importa calçados do Brasil são os Estados Unidos
item.description: In July 2026, the U.S. was the largest importer of Brazilian footwear, purchasing $15.8 million worth, while Brazil imported $30.5 million in shoes, mostly from Vietnam. The footwear industry faces external pressures, such as the 37.5% tariff imposed by Trump, and domestic challenges, with Lula's new decree eliminating import taxes, threatening 53,900 jobs.

item.title: Vietnã é país de onde mais vêm calçados importados pelo Brasil
item.description: Vietnam leads Brazilian footwear imports, while the US is the main destination for Brazilian footwear exports. The industry faces threats on both export and import fronts, with US tariffs and the removal of import taxes jeopardizing 53,900 jobs.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha tem estratégia de Marco Aurélio e banca exclusiva em Madri
item.description: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho coordinates Lulinha's defense in the influence trafficking investigations, serving as intermediary between Lula and Roberta Luchsinger. While pressuring against leaks and questioning the alleged 'Lava Jato wing' of the PF in Brazil, a team of seven lawyers in Madrid prepares the international defense. There are concerns about potential police actions against Lula's son.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio após números da semana
item.description: Recent polls show Lula leading Flávio in a hypothetical runoff, but within the margin of error, suggesting a technical tie. The gap between the two candidates ranges from three to four percentage points across institutes, maintaining stability in voting intentions. In the first round, Lula also leads numerically with an advantage over the runner-up.

item.title: Ana Castela faz o ‘V’ de vitória com Nikolas
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) shared a photo with singer Ana Castela at the Festa do Peão de Barretos, an event used as a stage for senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential campaign. The meeting reinforces alliances and visibility for PL figures in Minas Gerais during the pre-campaign period.

item.title: Palmeiras x Vasco no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Palmeiras and Vasco face off this Sunday, the 23rd, at 4 p.m., at Nubank Parque, in the 24th round of the Brazilian Championship. The match will be broadcast live by TV Globoost and Premiere. Palmeiras aims to strengthen its campaign after securing a spot in the Copa Libertadores quarterfinals.

item.title: A PF e o motivo da reaproximação de Davi Alcolumbre e Lula, segundo um aliado do petista
item.description: A close associate of Lula claims that Davi Alcolumbre's rapprochement with the president stems from convergences on security issues and foreign relations, aiming to consolidate alliances ahead of the 2026 electoral cycle.

item.title: MPE não vê irregularidade em foto de Lula com chapéu
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry determined that Lula's photo wearing a hat in his candidacy application has no irregularity, stating the accessory does not constitute election propaganda nor hinder candidate recognition. The body argued that allowing the hat supports political pluralism, a key principle of the Democratic Rule of Law.

item.title: O filho do pai e o pai do filho (por Mary Zaidan)
item.description: The article examines investigations involving children of famous politicians, highlighting differences in media and judicial treatment. It questions the impartiality of accusations during election periods and suggests intentional misinformation to sway public opinion.

item.title: Os dois chapéus de Sidônio, na Secom e na campanha de Lula
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, head of the Secretariat for Communication, works both in government management and directly in Lula's campaign, while his former partner Raul Rabelo took over as campaign strategist. The article highlights the overlap of roles and Sidônio's parallel activities outside the Planalto Palace.

item.title: Ministério Público Eleitoral não vê irregularidade na foto de Lula com chapéu na urna
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office stated to the TSE that there is no irregularity in President Lula's photo wearing a hat on the electronic ballot, authorizing the accessory due to medical recommendation. The decision supports political pluralism, according to Deputy Attorney General Alexandre Espinosa, and shows no electoral propaganda connotation.
